name: Minimum Echo Time
description: Reminder to verify minimum TE is used to preserve signal from T2/T2* decay. (From the ASL Clinical Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].iloc[0]
raise ValidationWarning(f"Echo Time is {te} ms. Verify this is the minimum TE available for your sequence - minimum TE should always be used for ASL to preserve signal from T2/T2* decay.")

testCases.name: TE reminder
testCases.description: Always warns to verify minimum TE
